newsitem.title: USA: Planet Hollywood, AMC in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Planet Hollywood, AMC in joint venture.

text.p: Planet Hollywood International Inc said Thursday that it and AMC Entertainment Inc have formed a joint venture to develop, own and operate a unique, integrated moviegoing, dining and retail concept worldwide.
The new complexes, which will be branded "Planet Movies by AMC," will combine AMC's megaplex with Planet Hollywood-theming.
Planet Hollywood said the venture plans to open complexes worldwide with the objective of having icon locations in major metropolitan and other select areas.
To initiate the venture, seven existing AMC megaplex theatres with more than 150 screens will be re-branded under a license arrangement to incorporate certain elements of the new concept, it said.
The venture will own and operate all subsequent units, including eight to 10 complexes with 200 to 250 screens over the next 12 to 24 months.
Over the longer term, the venture anticipates rolling out units at the rate of five to 10 per year.
